opening.argument: The speaker explains that learning C teaches the nature of computation, and the video points viewers to a free C programming course. That is an educational discussion of programming, not an earnings pitch: when the four-week path to a $200,000 Rust income comes up, the speaker expressly calls it a fallacy. The Apple stock remark is likewise a past account of advice to his brother-in-law, qualified by the speaker's admission that he is usually wrong about stock purchases. It is not a current investment solicitation.

citations.quote: I am suggesting that you learn it because it teaches you about the nature of computation.
And four weeks later, you're going to be making $200,000 as a Rust programmer. That's just a fallacy, right?
I called my brother-in-law, and I said, if you have any money, buy Apple Stock right now.
I've bought stock and usually I'm wrong.
